sourceBasis: Original procedural proposals grounded in existing P01–P04 contracts and C12 reference limitations. No new validated medical threshold or condition-specific dose is claimed.

parameters.scope: Must be defined by accepted population/task policy before dependent numerical or clinical behavior; no default is inferred.

rules.name: Health-change precedence
rules.when: new concern, required check missing or active hold
rules.action: Do not propose a lighter session as clearance; route through accepted clinical policy.
rules.scope: adult supported task only; accepted clinical/content policy and coach approval remain required
rules.precedence: Clinical/session authority, source validity and hard constraints precede numerical/relevance proposals.

rules.name: Source confirmation
rules.when: wellness untouched, missing, invalid, future or conflicting
rules.action: No numerical wellness adjustment; distinguish optional missing wellness from required health check.
rules.scope: adult supported task only; accepted clinical/content policy and coach approval remain required
rules.precedence: Clinical/session authority, source validity and hard constraints precede numerical/relevance proposals.

rules.name: Scale comparability
rules.when: source method/scale/direction differs from accepted baseline
rules.action: Do not combine categories, scores or device measures without accepted comparability.
rules.scope: adult supported task only; accepted clinical/content policy and coach approval remain required
rules.precedence: Clinical/session authority, source validity and hard constraints precede numerical/relevance proposals.

rules.name: Time change
rules.action: Recompose using full work/rest/setup/side time; omit optional work then show required gaps.
rules.scope: adult supported task only; accepted clinical/content policy and coach approval remain required
rules.precedence: Clinical/session authority, source validity and hard constraints precede numerical/relevance proposals.

rules.name: Equipment change
rules.when: actual required kit or anchor unavailable
rules.action: Filter affected variants and propose only independently eligible alternatives; no load transfer.
rules.scope: adult supported task only; accepted clinical/content policy and coach approval remain required
rules.precedence: Clinical/session authority, source validity and hard constraints precede numerical/relevance proposals.

rules.name: Support/access change
rules.when: assistance, transfer access or required support unavailable
rules.action: Check individual task requirements; no diagnosis-wide exclusion or assumed helper.
rules.scope: adult supported task only; accepted clinical/content policy and coach approval remain required
rules.precedence: Clinical/session authority, source validity and hard constraints precede numerical/relevance proposals.

rules.name: Accepted wellness adjustment
rules.when: confirmed comparable signal matches accepted scoped rule
rules.action: Apply approved parameter once against baseline; unresolved limits require coach review.
rules.scope: adult supported task only; accepted clinical/content policy and coach approval remain required
rules.precedence: Clinical/session authority, source validity and hard constraints precede numerical/relevance proposals.

rules.name: Overlapping signals
rules.action: Deduplicate source lineage and return one change or explicit conflict; no multiplied reductions.
rules.scope: adult supported task only; accepted clinical/content policy and coach approval remain required
rules.precedence: Clinical/session authority, source validity and hard constraints precede numerical/relevance proposals.

rules.name: Repeated request
rules.action: Do not compound or treat retry as a new adjustment; reconcile operation identity.
rules.scope: adult supported task only; accepted clinical/content policy and coach approval remain required
rules.precedence: Clinical/session authority, source validity and hard constraints precede numerical/relevance proposals.

rules.name: Load increments
rules.when: proposed load falls between available increments
rules.action: Use accepted rounding policy only within bounds; impossible increment returns review.
rules.scope: adult supported task only; accepted clinical/content policy and coach approval remain required
rules.precedence: Clinical/session authority, source validity and hard constraints precede numerical/relevance proposals.

rules.name: Mid-session proposal
rules.when: actuals already exist for part of session
rules.action: Preserve completed targets/actuals and identify exactly remaining work; recheck authority.
rules.scope: adult supported task only; accepted clinical/content policy and coach approval remain required
rules.precedence: Clinical/session authority, source validity and hard constraints precede numerical/relevance proposals.

rules.name: Authority stale/unavailable
rules.when: context or plan changed, content revoked or server unavailable
rules.action: No assignment/start/resume; preserve labelled draft and reconcile save outcome.
rules.scope: adult supported task only; accepted clinical/content policy and coach approval remain required
rules.precedence: Clinical/session authority, source validity and hard constraints precede numerical/relevance proposals.

rules.name: No qualifying change
rules.when: all required sources usable; no accepted rule fires
rules.action: Retain approved plan subject to current eligibility; not a medical safety guarantee.
rules.scope: adult supported task only; accepted clinical/content policy and coach approval remain required
rules.precedence: Clinical/session authority, source validity and hard constraints precede numerical/relevance proposals.

rules.name: Optional connection
rules.when: unapproved wearable/AI source or simulated measurement
rules.action: Do not enable new sharing/integration or treat simulated data as device evidence.
rules.scope: adult supported task only; accepted clinical/content policy and coach approval remain required
rules.precedence: Clinical/session authority, source validity and hard constraints precede numerical/relevance proposals.
